description: Searches sebbi.pro's 755 compliance checks across 32 frameworks (EU AI Act, GDPR, DORA, ISO/IEC 42001 and 27001, NIST AI RMF, UK Online Safety Act, EU DSA, SOC 2, PCI DSS, HIPAA, CCPA, NIS2, Cyber Resilience Act, ICO Children's Code, US state AI laws, model risk, and agent-output gates). Filter by framework and/or words; returns each check's id, title, what it needs and the framework list. Then run one with sebbi_run_check or a whole framework with sebbi_run_framework. Read-only.

framework.description: Framework key, e.g. euaiact, gdpr, dora, iso42001. Leave out to list frameworks.

search.description: Words to look for in the check titles, e.g. 'human oversight' or 'retention'.

name: sebbi_find_checks
title: Find compliance checks
